## What I expected

Describe what the documentation, diagram, or code led you to expect.

## What I observed

Describe the actual behavior or the part that was confusing or incorrect.

## Steps to reproduce

Include the file or page, commands, inputs, seed, runtime, or sequence of clicks where relevant. If you cannot reproduce it yet, explain what you were reading or trying to learn.

## Evidence

Paste test output, a screenshot, SVG diff, relevant snippet, or other evidence. Please avoid posting secrets or private data.

## Why it matters

What does this block you from understanding, testing, or doing?

## Suggested correction (optional)

A proposed fix is welcome, but a clear report is valuable even if you do not yet know how to fix it.

## Provenance / implementation status (if relevant)

- [ ] The image or statement appears to describe behavior that is implemented.
- [ ] It appears to be a conceptual or research illustration.
- [ ] I am unsure; please help classify it.

## Contributor context (optional)

Are you a student, teacher, hobbyist, maintainer, or another kind of reader? Share only what is useful to understand the report.
